mapper.select: SELECT target.id AS target_student_id, target.student_number, target.student_name, building.id AS building_id, building.building_name, room.id AS room_id, room.room_number, bed.id AS bed_id, bed.bed_code, bed.bed_type FROM student target JOIN room_assignment target_residency ON target_residency.student_id=target.id AND target_residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' JOIN room ON room.id=target_residency.room_id JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.id=room.floor_id JOIN dormitory_building building ON building.id=floor.building_id LEFT JOIN bed ON bed.id=target_residency.bed_id JOIN student requester ON requester.id=#{requesterStudentId} WHERE target.id<>#{requesterStudentId} AND target.student_number=#{studentNumber} AND target.student_name=#{studentName} AND building.id=#{buildingId} AND room.room_number=#{roomNumber} AND target.gender=requester.gender AND target.student_category=requester.student_category AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM room_exchange_participant_lock participant_lock WHERE participant_lock.student_id=target.id ) LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT building.id AS value, CONCAT(building.building_code, ' · ', building.building_name) AS label FROM dormitory_building building JOIN dormitory_floor floor ON floor.building_id=building.id JOIN room ON room.floor_id=floor.id JOIN room_assignment residency ON residency.room_id=room.id AND residency.assignment_status='ACTIVE' JOIN student target ON target.id=residency.student_id JOIN student requester ON requester.id=#{requesterStudentId} WHERE building.enabled=1 AND target.gender=requester.gender AND target.student_category=requester.student_category ORDER BY label
